summary: A solid, production-leaning TSDB design using WAL+head to immutable time-partitioned blocks, quorum replication per shard, and aggressive query pruning via tag index and block metadata. It covers core TSDB concerns (high cardinality, out-of-order, rollups, retention/tiering, multi-tenancy) with practical operational guardrails and clear failure/DR thinking.
strengths: End-to-end coverage of ingest/query/maintenance with realistic SLOs, multi-tenant quotas, and backpressure/admission control.
Good storage-engine shape (WAL+head→immutable blocks, compaction/rollups/tombstones) and pragmatic tiering/repair/DR story.
weaknesses: Key correctness details are underspecified: leader election/consensus semantics, split-brain prevention mechanics, replica catch-up, and read consistency guarantees under failover.

Indexing and metadata scaling under extreme cardinality (memory footprint, postings list management, query planning across shards) and the Control DB’s role as a potential bottleneck need sharper design/limits.
